text:
I’m passionate about data work and I’m a hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’d be glad to help with your executive contact research project. I understand you need accurate, up-to-date contact information for identified executives, including verified email addresses, direct dial office phone numbers, and LinkedIn URLs found through Sales Navigator. I’m comfortable working carefully with structured lists, doing online research, and organizing prospect data in a clean, usable format for business development.

In a recent project, I built a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. I replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports with one Power BI report on a star-schema model, which reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project required careful data modeling, accuracy, and consistency across sources.

I also built customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home using Google Sheets, Looker Studio, and Shopify exports. I created segments based on recency, frequency, and spend, then fed them to the email tool. The top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and email revenue increased by 19%. That work strengthened my ability to clean data, structure lists, and deliver information that supports outreach and revenue goals.

For your project, I would focus on accuracy, completeness, and clean list building. I can help verify details, organize contact records clearly, and keep the output consistent so it’s easy for your team to use in prospecting. I’m comfortable handling repetitive research work with care and attention to detail.

If needed, I can also format the final list in Excel or Google Sheets so it’s ready for your sales process.

What format would you like the final deliverable in for each executive record?
